installerURLTmpl.description: The installer image reference, as a Go template over .RegistryURL, .ID, .Version, .Platform and .SecureBoot.

platform.description: The installer's platform: metal, openstack, aws, …. Default: metal.

protocol.description: The protocol schematics are submitted over. Default: https.

registryURL.description: The Image Factory host. Default: factory.talos.dev.

schematicEndpoint.description: The path schematics are submitted to. Default: /schematics.

secureBoot.description: Use the secure boot installer. Default: false.

groups.description: Groups whose patches this node receives, applied in this order after its role's.

hostname.description: An RFC 1123 host name: the Kubernetes node name, and the rendered file's name.

imageFactory.description: Overrides the cluster's imageFactory key by key for this node.

ipAddress.description: The address talman reaches the node at.

patches.description: This node's own patches, applied last.

schematic.description: Overrides the cluster's schematic for this node.

oneOf.description: A path to a schematic file.

schematicID.description: Overrides the cluster's schematic with an ID for this node.

talosVersion.description: Overrides the cluster's talosVersion for this node.

values.description: Free-form data, available to this node's patch templates as .Node.Values.

valuesFiles.description: YAML files merged into this node's values, in order and beneath its inline map.

soak.description: How long to wait after each wave before the next, e.g. 10m.

waves.description: Waves in order. A node goes in the first that names its role or a group of its; the rest go last.

description: A talman cluster config, schema talman.dev/v1.

apiVersion.description: The schema this file is written against.

clusterName.description: The cluster's name, as talosctl gen config takes it.

endpoint.description: The Kubernetes API URL: https, with a port.

imageFactory.description: Where installer images come from and how their references are spelled.

kubernetesVersion.description: The Kubernetes version configs are rendered for, and upgrade-k8s upgrades to.

outputDir.description: Where rendered configs, the talosconfig and the kubeconfig are written. Default: clusterconfig.

patches.description: Patch files by group: all, controlplane, worker, or a group some node declares. Applied in that order.

rollout.description: The order upgrade, reboot and apply take through the cluster, in waves of groups.

schematic.description: The Image Factory schematic: inline, or a path to a (templated) file.

oneOf.description: A path to a schematic file.

schematicID.description: A schematic ID to use as is, instead of a schematic.

secretFile.description: The (usually SOPS-encrypted) Talos secrets bundle. Default: secrets.sops.yaml.

talosVersion.description: The Talos version contract configs are rendered for. Pinning it makes renders reproducible.

talosctl.description: The talosctl binary talman drives. Default: talosctl on PATH.

validationMode.description: The talosctl validate --mode. Default: metal for the metal platform, cloud otherwise.

values.description: Free-form data, available to every patch template as .Values.

valuesFiles.description: YAML files merged into values, in order and beneath the inline map. Plaintext only.
